+ 会议须进行中（有人在会），会议不存在返回错误码 2101；会议结束、所有人离:
+ The meeting must be in progress (someone is in the meeting), and error code 2101 is returned if the meeting doesn't exist; when the meeting ends and everyone leaves, all of its pushes stop automatically
+ Calling again for the same push URL in the same meeting doesn't start another push: if the sources are unchanged, the existing push_id is returned; if they changed, this push is updated to the new sources
+ While a source doesn't exist yet (for example, the stream mixing task hasn't started, or the user to push hasn't published), the push stays in waiting; this is not a failure, and pushing starts automatically once the source appears
+ Pushes reconnect automatically after a disconnection; query push status with List push tasks
+ Error code 1072 is returned when no push service is available, and 1075 when the push URL is invalid

直播流位（8）已不再支持，task_type 含 8 时直接报错：请改用 2（合: The live stream bit (8) is no longer supported; if task_type includes 8, an error is returned: use stream mixing (2) to publish the composite video instead, then pull with stream/pull-url or push with stream/push/start.
直播流位（8）已并入合流（2），传了按合流处理：\n- 合成模式会议（或会议已自:
The live stream bit (8) has been merged into stream mixing (2) and is handled as stream mixing when passed:
- Composite-mode meetings (or meetings that have automatically started a stream mixing task): the meeting's composite video is reused as is and its layout isn't changed, so layout_data doesn't apply to this part; the other bits start their own tasks (for example, 9 starts only video recording 1), and 8 alone returns the task_id of the meeting's composite task directly
- Other meetings: a stream mixing task is started, and task_type in status callbacks is still the value you passed (8, 9, and so on)
直播流地址（兼容老接口，内部走 stream/pull-url）: Get live stream URLs (legacy endpoint, served by stream/pull-url internally)
直播流（task_type 含 8）有两种用法：\n- 拉流模式（不传 layo:
A live stream (task_type includes 8) can be used in two ways:
- Pull mode (no layout_data.push_url): while the task is in progress, get a signed HTTP-FLV URL with "Get live stream playback URL"
- Push mode (layout_data.push_url set): the server pushes the composite video to your RTMP URL (rtmp:// and rtmps:// are supported); the audio source is set by push_audio
(mix for the meeting's mixed audio, the default; none for no audio; user for a specific user's audio, with push_audio_uid and optionally push_audio_desc).
The push reconnects automatically after a disconnection; this API returns error code 1072 if no push service is available
